subject: RP8 JSON fixed, all cross-exam hard failures resolved
body:
GI — both issues you reported are resolved:

1. retake-practice-8.json invalid JSON: Fixed in commit ce95f8e. Root cause was a PowerShell replace that corrupted Q5 inputs array structure and Q14_k object. Now passes 313/313. JSON is valid.

2. cross-exam-verify 32 hard failures: Down to 0. Fixes applied across P4, P5, P6, P8 (commit 6e204ad) and P9 (commit c433f5b, 8 equations replaced).

Current scores: verify-practice-exams.js 2687/2687 ALL PASS. cross-exam-verify.js ZERO hard failures. lint-math-json.js 0 errors.

You can re-run your property tests now — all files should be clean.
